svg.title: Dark pixels in the R1 upper strip
svg.desc: Side-by-side masks of the same area of the unmarked photograph and the hunter's screenshot. All 878 dark pixel positions coincide. The lower panels enlarge the central 96 columns five times.

g.text: Dark pixels in the R1 upper strip
Columns 80–559, rows 2–31. Both masks select the same 878 of 14,400 positions.
